policy: Cached stamp-only feasibility; no downloads, candidate event flux comparisons, empirical individual-source PRF claims or host rankings. Exclude at least0.5day and3durations around every supplied frozen clock. Alternate2day blocks anchored at first finite time for out-of-event train/test. Fixed intercept+POS_CORR1/2 pixel regressions versus constant training mean; no tuning, no event evaluation. Placeholder or missing pointing means unavailable. This is aggregate-scene predictive adequacy, not source-response identification. Go to source model only after independent response identifiability and positive/negative host controls; no such successful controls presumed.
